title: A Trip to the Beach
text: Last weekend, my family went to the beach. The sea was blue and beautiful. We saw a big mountain far away. My brother and I played in the water. After lunch, we walked by a small river near the beach. It was a fun day!

questions.question: Where did the family go last weekend?
